project_type: SmartWaste: AWS SAM app. Python 3.12 Flask-on-Lambda-Web-Adapter backend (7 Lambdas), vanilla ES5-style JS SPA frontend (hash router, no build step), DynamoDB, Cognito, AppSync Events, Web Push.
build_system: AWS SAM (infra/template.yaml). No frontend build step — frontend/*.js|html|css are served as-is from S3. Backend Lambdas each have app.py + run.sh + requirements.txt.
test_framework: pytest (pytest.ini: testpaths=tests, addopts=-q). Pure-logic unit tests only; AWS deps (boto3/flask/jwt) are stubbed in tests/conftest.py so lambdas/collect/app.py imports without AWS/network.
build_command: No compile step for Python Lambdas or the vanilla JS SPA. For JS syntax checking use 'node --check frontend/app.js'. For infra: 'sam validate --template infra/template.yaml --region ap-southeast-1' if the SAM CLI is installed.
test_command: From the worktree root: 'pip install -r requirements-dev.txt' then 'pytest -q'. Run a single file with 'pytest tests/test_collect.py -q'.
verification_instructions: 1) Backend: run 'pytest -q' — all pure-logic unit tests (existing + new in tests/test_collect.py) must pass. 2) Frontend: 'node --check frontend/app.js' must report no syntax errors; functional behavior is manual (no JS test harness exists — this matches the repo's documented 'pure logic only' automated-test scope). 3) Infra: 'sam validate' if available, else confirm the new resources/env-vars/output parse by re-reading the edited sections. 4) Invariant check: re-read _creq_view, _chat_enabled, and BOTH list_requests call-sites to confirm no contact/chat is reachable before collect-request status 'confirmed'.
environment_constraints: OS is Windows; shell is PowerShell. Use ABSOLUTE paths under the worktree c:\programming\kiroaws\smartwaste-app\.worktrees\phase1-marketplace — relative paths land in the parent workspace. Git ops must target the worktree: 'git -C c:\programming\kiroaws\smartwaste-app\.worktrees\phase1-marketplace ...'. The branch is phase1-marketplace off mainline main. Commit locally; NEVER push. No AWS credentials/network in the test environment (tests stub AWS).
contribution_requirements: No new frameworks or build steps (locked in the design). Backend stays Python 3.12 Flask on Lambda Web Adapter; data stays DynamoDB; auth stays Cognito; frontend stays vanilla ES5-style JS with the hash router and collectFetch/profileFetch bearer helpers. NO real payments anywhere in Phase 1 — paymentStatus placeholder + '# Phase 2' comments only. Soft status only: cancel/dispute are status changes, NEVER DynamoDB deletes. Do NOT add a Cognito custom attribute (would replace the pool). Do NOT touch the Future Actions tab (renderFurtherActions) — the user explicitly declined re-ordering it.
key_patterns: Backend routing: handler() in lambdas/collect/app.py dispatches POST by route.endswith(...) in order and GET by suffix; a NEW prefix-based dispatcher (route.startswith('/admin/') / '/collector/') must be added IN FRONT of the endswith chain to avoid '/admin/collectors/{id}/approve' being captured by endswith('approve'). Views: public_view(item, owner) and _creq_view(cr, waste) shape responses; _creq_view unlocks contact only when status is in UNLOCK_STATUSES. Chat gate: _chat_enabled(cr). Notifications: notify(user_id, ntype, title, body, meta) + push_send. Helpers: _s() string-coerce, _get_waste(), _get_creq(), json_response(), _now_micros() (microseconds, for sort-key createdAt). New timestamps use int(time.time()) epoch SECONDS (confirmedAt/cancelledAt/disputedAt/verifiedAt). Money uses Decimal via a new _dec_price() rounding to 2dp. Frontend: statusBadge(status) label map + status-<name> CSS classes; fmtTime(ts) expects epoch SECONDS (new Date(ts*1000)); act(suffix,id,btn) posts {collectRequestId:id} then refreshes; showNotifDetailForCollectRequest(cr) + wireNotifDetailActions() + openRequestInNotifications(wasteId) + findCollectRequest(id) + renderIncomingQuotesForWaste(wasteId NEW); Auth.profile() has TWO return paths (live-session + localStorage) both needing a 'groups' field; ROUTES hash-router map; onPortalCardClick routes owner Track to notifications.
